description: SSH server config audit — Offline OpenSSH sshd_config audit. Pass text= (config contents) or url= (raw file; GitHub blob links work). Flags root login, password/empty-password auth, Protocol 1, rhosts/host-based auth, weak ciphers/MACs/KEX, SHA-1/DSA keys, forwarding, StrictModes, MaxAuthTries, idle timeouts, missing AllowUsers/AllowGroups, misspelled keywords and duplicate keywords that sshd silently ignores (first value wins); Match blocks reported separately. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, 0-100 score, A-F grade, findings with line numbers and fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
